newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end up sightly as blue chips gain.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end up sightly as blue chips gain.

text.p: Dhaka stocks end up marginally as investors were selective in trading and targeted mostly blue chip shares, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index closed 1.23 points or 0.06 percent up at 1,875.76 on a turnover of 44.2 million taka. Of 94 traded issues 50 gained and 40 lost.

"The retail investors were cautious in making fresh commitments. They were choosy in buying scrips," one broker said. Amam Sea Food Industries gained 169 to 3,879, Confidence Cement lost 10 to 963, Singer Bangladesh gained 61 to 11,883 and Beximco Pharma shed one to 187.
